meta.title: Retro Press
meta.description: A theme workshop: fifteen palettes, from a woodcut seal to CRT phosphor, including three single-ink editorial poster pages (Ink only, Cobalt, Risograph), each redrawing the DeepSeek whale in its own ink, with drop caps, chapter rules, paper grain or scanlines, corners, double rules, density and type pairing — plus a phosphor layer on code in dark mode. Everything switches from its own Settings page.
